description: Dramaturge's wake conditions — each a predicate over the graph, each independently tunable. Only live:true wakes run; the others are DECLARED placeholders (contract first, implementation when deliberately enabled). Edit params, flip live, re-run tools/dramaturge.py, and watch how the beats arrive differently — this file is the play surface.

wakes.predicate: A lesson with at least `min_scenes` scenes and no lesson_start beat gets a proposed welcome (pedagogical: hook); no lesson_end beat gets a proposed closure (pedagogical: transfer).

PLACEHOLDER — a voice proposal carrying an invented-risk flag with a '(withheld)' span marks copy the register wanted and the atom couldn't anchor: propose an after_element beat (rhetorical: persuade) at that element, so the warmth gets a governed home instead of leaking into a rendering.
PLACEHOLDER — a lesson whose elected hook scene has no persuade beat within `reach` scenes: propose a scene_end persuade beat to land the 'why this matters' the hook opened.
PLACEHOLDER — more than `max_run` consecutive topic scenes with no beat and no check: propose a scene_end transition beat (rhetorical: transition) to break the run.
